subject: Post-POC metrics recap + 15-min quote / recording permission
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Randolph <alex.randolph@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-POC metrics recap + 15-min quote / recording permission

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for running the two-week POC with our low-latency recommendation endpoint. We ran a quick analysis from the pilot logs and wanted to share the headline results and a short ask. I kept this tight since I know you and the team are heads-down.

Pilot highlights (production-like traffic patterns):
- 12% lift in add-to-cart rate on the variant using Redwood reranking (95% CI: 8–16%)
- 28% reduction in median inference latency (from 210ms -> 152ms) after applying our KV cache and optimized batching config
- Cost per 1k queries dropped ~18% vs baseline due to prefix caching and lower per-token compute

Attached is the short KPI export we used to compile the above (acme-pilot-kpis.pdf).

Request: would Acme be open to two small things to help us share these findings internally and externally?
1) A very short written quote (2–3 lines) on outcomes and whether we can attribute the numbers to AcmeRetail. I attached a one-page template you can use to make it easier (redwood-quote-template.docx).
2) A brief 15-minute recording or call we can capture (audio only) where someone from your product/analytics team confirms the outcomes — nothing scripted, just a quick sanity check.

We can keep anything off the public site if procurement needs to sign an approval first; happy to route through your normal legal path. Proposed times: Tue 9/5 10:00–10:15 PT or Wed 9/6 11:00–11:15 PT. I’ve added a one-click calendar link below for the Tue slot.

Next steps: if you can confirm who the best contact is for the quote + whether Tuesday works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a single-slide summary we can record against.

Thanks — really enjoyed working with you on this and appreciate how quickly your engineers iterated.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: acme-pilot-kpis.pdf] [Attachment: redwood-quote-template.docx]

--
Grace O'Connor
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Randolph <alex.randolph@acme-retail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Stakeholders <pilot-stakeholders@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Sep 2028 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-POC metrics recap + 15-min quote / recording permission

Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap and the export. The team is pleased with the add-to-cart lift and the latency wins. A few quick notes from our side:
- The numbers look consistent with our A/B slices. Nice work on the caching adjustments.
- Procurement will need a brief statement in writing before we publish anything. They usually require a 1–2 business day review.

We can do the 15-minute recording on Tue 9/5 at 10:00 PT — that works for me and I can ask Priya (lead analyst) to join for the first 5 minutes to confirm the metrics.

For the quote: can you share a suggested 2–3 line blurb that we can approve/edit? Makes the internal review faster. Also: fine to record audio, but we’d like the recording used only for case-study purposes and not for sales audio ads — procurement will want that restriction called out.

If you can send a calendar invite for Tue and a draft blurb, I’ll route both through procurement and legal.

Appreciate the partnership — Alex
Alex Randolph
Sr. Product Manager, Recommendations | AcmeRetail
alex.randolph@acme-retail.com | +1 (203) 555-0124
